candidates: Proofread inline code comments—including explanatory comments inside catch blocks—for correct spelling, grammar, and article usage (e.g., 'an unattached' not 'a unnattached').

When reviewing `withMdxComponentOverride` (code/addons/docs/src/blocks/blocks/with-mdx-component-override.tsx) or any HOC that resolves component overrides via React context at render time, verify the re-entry guard is scoped exactly: skip override resolution only when the current block name is already present in the `MdxWrappedBlockContext` set (preventing self-referential loops where an override composes with its own public export) or when the resolved override is literally the same wrapped export reference (`Override === WrappedBlock`). Any broader check—such as testing for a `[MDX_WRAPPED_BLOCK]` symbol on the candidate override—incorrectly rejects valid cross-block overrides like `docs.components.Title = Subtitle` and must be avoided.

When writing or modifying MDX fixture files that reference story named exports via `<Story of={StoryModule.ExportName} />`, `<Canvas of={...} />`, `<Source of={...} />`, or `<DocsStory of={...} />`, cross-check every referenced export identifier against the actual named exports of the imported stories module; a mismatch is not caught at build time and causes a runtime error when the docs page renders.

Renaming story directories or changing `titlePrefix` values in `.storybook/main.ts` alters story IDs, invalidating existing Chromatic visual-test snapshots and requiring explicit baseline re-acceptance. Flag this impact in the MR description so reviewers can approve the snapshot changes deliberately rather than treating them as regressions.

When implementing non-obvious re-entry or cycle-detection logic (for example, a React context set used to track which block names are currently mid-resolution), add an inline comment for each guard condition that explains: (a) the specific scenario that condition prevents, and (b) why a simpler alternative would be too broad or too narrow. The logic in `withMdxComponentOverride` is a canonical example where reviewers struggled to understand why each branch was necessary without additional prose.
